sections.Interpretation: Marked normocytic-to-macrocytic anaemia is present with a haemoglobin of 7.8 g/dL and a markedly raised MCV of about 118 fL, indicating a macrocytic anaemia. The MCHC is within the normal range, and the RDW is raised, consistent with anisocytosis. Mild leukopenia and mild thrombocytopenia accompany the anaemia, a pattern that, together with the strict vegetarian diet, fatigue, paraesthesia and glossitis, is suggestive of vitamin B12 deficiency. The findings may also reflect folate deficiency or another cause of ineffective erythropoiesis, and there is no critical value on this report. Serum vitamin B12 and folate levels are recommended, with further assessment as clinically indicated.
